title: Security Operations Activity Map
description: Interactive Mermaid map of security operations as one feedback loop: offensive, defensive, and response functions fed by threat intelligence and integrated by a purple team.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Security operations functions and their feedback loop
learningObjectives: Relate the offensive, defensive, and response functions of security operations and the activities under each.
Explain how findings, alerts, and lessons cycle between the three functions.
Describe the integrative role of the purple team and the cross-cutting role of threat intelligence.
educational.prerequisites: Awareness that organizations both attack their own systems (testing) and defend them.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to trace a finding around the loop and to place specific job roles into the three functions.
misconceptionsAddressed: Seeing offense, defense, and response as three unrelated teams rather than one feedback loop.
Treating threat intelligence as a single team's resource rather than a shared input to all functions.
